**Triage Summary:**

Log4j-core 2.14.1 contains two critical remote code execution vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-44228 and CVE-2021-45046) with maximum EPSS scores and active exploitation in the wild (KEV catalog). Both vulnerabilities have available fixes and appear as duplicate findings across different dependency declarations. This is a high-priority supply chain risk requiring immediate remediation.

**Recommended Action:** Upgrade log4j-core to version 2.17.1 or later without delay. Block this build and flag for immediate patching—do not permit deployment with 2.14.1.
